page_title: BOC 1-1 AUG | Bochum v Augsburg 03/02/2024, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+6' That's all for today as the game is over.
90+3' Philipp Hofmann (Bochum) joins the action as a substitute, replacing Matus Bero.
90+1' 1 - 1 Goal! Ermedin Demirovic (Augsburg) wins the battle of wills and sends an unstoppable penalty past Manuel Riemann into the bottom left corner.
90+1' Ermedin Demirovic (Augsburg) is heading towards the penalty spot to take it.
90' We will have 6 min. of added time.
90' The Augsburg players are happy as the referee awards a PENALTY after the VAR review!
90' There's a break in play and referee Patrick Ittrich must have got a signal in his ear as he indicates he will check that earlier penalty claim by Augsburg using VAR. This could be interesting!
89' Surely that's handball by one of the Bochum players in the box, but the referee just waves play on!
89' Pep Biel (Augsburg) rolls the ball short to a teammate from the corner instead of sending a cross into the box.
89' The ball is cleared after Kevin Mbabu (Augsburg) attempted to dribble past an opposing player. Augsburg have been awarded a corner kick.
87' Arne Maier (Augsburg) fails to pick a body out in the box with an over-hit chip pass.
86' The goalkeeper pulls off a decent save to deny Ermedin Demirovic (Augsburg) as he jumps for a header from a brilliant cross into the penalty area.
86' Arne Maier (Augsburg) is found in space by a decent pass, and he immediately hits a rocket of a shot at goal that clips the outside of the left post.
86' Kevin Mbabu (Augsburg) flights in the cross, but the defender is alert and clears to safety.
83' Augsburg failed to take advantage of the corner as the opposition's defence was alert and averted the threat.
83' Arne Engels (Augsburg) tries to send a pass but it's blocked. The linesman points to the corner flag, Augsburg are going to take it.
83' Kevin Mbabu (Augsburg) sends a cross into the box, but the opposition's defence quickly intercepts the ball.
81' The referee stops play so that a substitution can be made and Ruben Vargas leaves the pitch and Mads Pedersen (Augsburg) comes on.
81' Jess Thorup has decided to make a change. Arne Maier (Augsburg) replaces Kristijan Jakic.

80' Nice move, nice attempt! Matus Bero (Bochum) is teed up with a simple pass after a nice flowing move. His first time shot from mid-range looks like it's going in but curls just wide of the right post.
80' Keven Schlotterbeck (Bochum) slides a pass forward, but one of the defenders cuts it out.
79' Moritz Broschinski goes off the pitch and Maximilian Wittek (Bochum) comes on.
77' Bochum fail to score from a corner as Finn Dahmen (Augsburg) leaps to collect the ball.

77' Matus Bero (Bochum) controls a reverse pass deep inside the box and smacks the ball low towards the middle of the goal, but the Finn Dahmen anticipates well and smothers the ball. The referee and one of his assistants signal for a corner kick to Bochum.
76' What was Patrick Osterhage (Bochum) thinking? He will not get away with that. The referee shows him a yellow card.
74' The resulting set piece from Augsburg is comfortably intercepted by one of the defending players.
74' Arne Engels (Augsburg) wastes a good opportunity as his pass into the box is blocked by the defence. Corner kick. Augsburg will have an opportunity.
74' Sven Michel (Augsburg) delivers a lovely cross into the penalty area. Nevertheless, an opposition defender is alert and averts the danger with a brilliant clearance.
72' Arne Engels (Augsburg) is adjudged offside.
70' This yellow card was deserved. The tackle by Kristijan Jakic (Augsburg) was quite harsh and Patrick Ittrich didn't hesitate to show him a yellow card.
69' Sven Michel (Augsburg) gets to the rebound just outside the box, but his attempt is blocked by one of the defending players.
68' The referee stops play so that a substitution can be made and Kevin Stoger departs the field of play to be replaced by Keven Schlotterbeck (Bochum).
68' The manager makes a subsitution with Moritz-Broni Kwarteng (Bochum) coming on for Christopher Antwi-Adjei.
68' Jess Thorup has decided to introduce fresh legs, with Sven Michel (Augsburg) replacing Fredrik Jensen.
68' Substitution. Elvis Rexhbecaj walks off the pitch and Arne Engels (Augsburg) comes on as a substitute.
68' Patrick Ittrich blows his whistle after Matus Bero (Bochum) brings one of his opponents down with a strong tackle.
66' Anthony Losilla (Bochum) slides a pass forward, but one of the defenders cuts it out.
64' A cross is clipped into the penalty area by Elvis Rexhbecaj (Augsburg) but poses no threat.
64' Kevin Mbabu (Augsburg) fails to find any of his teammates inside the box as his pass is blocked.
61' Ruben Vargas (Augsburg) controls a nice lofted pass and shoots from the edge of the box, but his attempt is neither hard nor precise, so Manuel Riemann stops it easily.
60' The referee stops play so that a substitution can be made and Phillip Tietz trots off the pitch and is replaced by Pep Biel (Augsburg).
59' Jeffrey Gouweleeuw (Augsburg) attempts to find one of his teammates with a fine lofted pass, but the defence reacts well to intercept the effort.
55' Fredrik Jensen (Augsburg) takes the corner but fails to find any of his teammates. The ball is easily cleared out of danger.

55' Elvis Rexhbecaj (Augsburg) attempts to find the head of one of his teammates with a promising cross into the box, but a defender outjumps the attackers and averts the threat. It will be a corner kick for Augsburg.
53' Kevin Stoger (Bochum) plays a through ball but overhits it.
52' Matus Bero (Bochum) sets himself up and has a crack at goal from the edge of the box. The shot heads low to the middle of the goal, but Finn Dahmen tracks it all the way and makes an easy save.
51' Another attempt to send the ball beyond the defence by Kevin Mbabu (Augsburg) is thwarted and cleared to safety.
50' Phillip Tietz (Augsburg) sends a pass into the box, but the opposition's defence is alert to the danger and makes a clearance.
48' Patrick Osterhage (Bochum) attempts to slip the ball through the defence, but is unable to find any of his teammates.
47' Kristijan Jakic (Augsburg) found some space to dink a cross from the side into the box, but it needed to be more precise to threaten the opposition.
46' Matus Bero (Bochum) delivers a fine lofted cross into the penalty area, but it's cleared by an opposing player.
46' Everything is set for the start of the second half.
45+5' Patrick Ittrich has ended the first half by blowing the whistle.
45+5' Tim Oermann (Bochum) is cautioned by the referee for a foul that he committed a little earlier.
45+3' Christopher Antwi-Adjei (Bochum) is angry with himself. The ball breaks to him but he hits the right post!
45+1' A raking crossfield pass from Fredrik Jensen (Augsburg) lacks accuracy and the opposition gain possession.
45' 4 additional min. will be played.
44' Moritz Broschinski (Bochum) takes his opponent down and receives a yellow card from the referee.
43' A pass by Fredrik Jensen (Augsburg) ends up in no man's land, and the attacking effort comes to an end.
42' Patrick Ittrich blows his whistle and it's Ermedin Demirovic (Augsburg) who is penalised for an offensive foul. Good decision by the referee.
41' Iago (Augsburg) reacts well to latch onto a rebound inside the box, but his shot is well blocked.
38' Kevin Stoger (Bochum) once again attempts to send a defence-splitting pass, but the opposition's defence is alert and intercepts the ball.
37' Kristijan Jakic (Augsburg) misses the left post by a whisker with a mid-range rebound. What a chance that was!
36' Christopher Antwi-Adjei (Bochum) fails to send a pass into the box as his effort is cut out.
35' Iago (Augsburg) whips the ball in, but it fails to reach any of his teammates as the opposition's defence averts the threat.
34' Fredrik Jensen (Augsburg) delivers a long ball, but it lacks enough power to reach his teammates and is intercepted by one of the defenders.
33' 1 - 0 GOAL! Moritz Broschinski (Bochum) gets to the rebound inside the box and fires in a stunning overhead kick. Phenomenal finish! 1:0.
32' A good clearance by a defender means the corner comes to nothing for Bochum.

31' Phillip Tietz (Augsburg) is obviously not following the Golden Rule: "Treat others as you want to be treated.“ He makes a bad challenge and leaves Patrick Ittrich with no other option than to blow for a foul.
31' Elvis Rexhbecaj (Augsburg) delivers a promising cross into the box, but it's cleared.
28' Patrick Osterhage (Bochum) gets on the ball and beats an opponent, but his run is stopped by the referee Patrick Ittrich who sees an offensive foul.
27' Tim Oermann (Bochum) receives a good pass and from just outside the box he unleashes a promising strike, but the shot is blocked by the defender.
27' Ermedin Demirovic (Augsburg) collects a pass on the edge of the box and unleashes a low drive to the middle, but Manuel Riemann makes a save.
25' Ermedin Demirovic (Augsburg) pounces on the cross into the centre of the box, but hangs his head in shame after sending his header well wide of the left post when the keeper was on his backside.
24' Felix Uduokhai (Augsburg) produces a lovely chip pass into the box, but one of the opposition players cuts it out.
20' One of the defenders reacts at the last minute to brilliantly block a pass from Elvis Rexhbecaj (Augsburg).
19' Phillip Tietz (Augsburg) latches on to an accurate pass on the edge of the box and unleashes a strong shot towards goal, but his effort is denied by the well positioned keeper.
18' Anthony Losilla (Bochum) is penalised for a foul. Patrick Ittrich had a clear view and blows his whistle.
17' A pass by Phillip Tietz (Augsburg) ends up in no man's land, and the attacking effort comes to an end.

16' Christopher Antwi-Adjei (Bochum) rises high to head a nice lofted cross low towards the middle of the goal. Unfortunately for him, his close-range effort lacks pace and Finn Dahmen makes a comfortable save.
13' Half-chance! Christopher Antwi-Adjei (Bochum) plays a pass into the box, but Finn Dahmen reacts well to snuff out the attack.
12' Elvis Rexhbecaj (Augsburg) looks to break free, but an opposing player clears the ball away.
11' Elvis Rexhbecaj (Augsburg) whips in the corner, but one of the defending players gets a head on it and intercepts.

11' Elvis Rexhbecaj (Augsburg) attempts to find his teammate with a pass from outside the box, but the opposition's defence is quick to react and thwarts the attack. Augsburg force a corner. They send men into the box.
10' Patrick Osterhage (Bochum) beats an opponent and drives towards the edge of the penalty area. He steadies himself and hits a tremendous shot that flashes a whisker past the left post.
9' Elvis Rexhbecaj (Augsburg) swings a cross into the box, but it's far too close to Manuel Riemann, who smothers the ball.
8' Patrick Osterhage (Bochum) produces a lovely ball into the penalty area but the defender manages to intercept and comfortably averts the danger.
7' A fine lofted pass into the box, sent by Christopher Antwi-Adjei (Bochum), is intercepted by the opposition's defence.
7' Patrick Osterhage (Bochum) decides to take a short corner instead of crossing into the box.
7' Christopher Antwi-Adjei (Bochum) sends a pass into the box, but his attempt is thwarted and cleared. The referee points to the corner flag. It's a corner to Bochum.
6' Fredrik Jensen (Augsburg) tries to slide the ball through to a teammate but it's well blocked by a defender.
2' A pass by Tim Oermann (Bochum) ends up in no man's land, and the attacking effort comes to an end.
1' The match has just started.
The players are on the pitch and Augsburg will have the kick-off.
Patrick Ittrich is the one to supervise the game today.
Show lineups The starting XIs were already announced and you can go through them in the Lineups section.
